subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A period of ten years
solution:
The correct answer is **Decade.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **decade **means a period of ten years.

 
 
• **Example: *** Environment has changed a lot **during the last two decades.**​*
 
• *iPad is one of the greatest inventions of the past decade.*
 
 
 
• ​The word "decade" was first used in the fifteenth century.

Therefore, the option **Decade** is correct. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **fortnight** means a period of two weeks.
 
• **Millennium** refers to a thousand-year period or the end of a thousand-year period.
 
• **Centenary** refers to (the day or year) 100 years after a significant event.
